limitations: Sections 1.6, 1.10 and 5 tie the grantor and Original Code to the Exhibit A notice. The archive alone identifies neither for a particular work.
reasoning: MPL 1.0 §2.1(a) enumerates all seven acts for Original Code or portions, with or without Modifications or as part of a Larger Work. The opening sentence names the Initial Developer as grantor, You as recipient, and makes the worldwide, royalty-free, nonexclusive grant subject to third-party intellectual-property claims.
